title: Apple Event September 2022: iPhone 14 Pro summary slide
lede: The dark version of Apple’s summary grid for iPhone 14 Pro, with a large product tile in the middle and violet gradient type.
summary: Near-black rounded tiles on black around a large purple iPhone 14 Pro, with violet gradient headings. September 2022.

source.label: Apple Summary Slides (fan archive): Apple Event September 2022

evidence.note: Inspected the 1920 × 1080 WebP `[Apple Event September 2022]-[iPhone]-[iPhone 14 Pro].webp` from the fan archive [Apple Summary Slides](https://apple-summary-slides.vercel.app/events/apple-event-september-2022) (Ricky Zhang), which says that all images are screenshots of Apple event videos. The copy is a frame of the event video, not an Apple press file. Not stored.

styles.note: Clear: the dark variant of the core look, often cited as the model for the bento trend.

context: Apple introduced iPhone 14 Pro at its event on 7 September 2022. Deck.gallery lists the Apple Event Product Summary 2022 among four Apple bento decks ([Deck.gallery](https://www.deck.gallery/blog/apple-bento-grid-decks-roundup/)).
observed: The ground is black and the tiles are a slightly lighter near-black, with large rounded corners and narrow even gutters.
About twenty tiles of different sizes fill the frame. The largest tile, in the center, shows the top of a deep purple iPhone 14 Pro with its camera, cropped by the tile edge.
Several key words are set large in bold type filled with a violet or blue gradient: “ProMotion”, “Always-On display”, “Ultra Wide”, “48MP”, “Action mode”.
Smaller tiles carry white labels with one image each: a green battery ring, a MagSafe charger, four phone colors, an A16 Bionic chip.
Numbers appear as large blue headings with white labels: “1600 nits”, “2000 nits”.
interpretation: The dark slide shows that the look is not a color scheme. What stays the same as the light slides is the rounded tonal tile, the narrow gutter, the mixed sizes, and the one-fact-per-tile rule.
borrow: On a dark ground, use tiles only a few steps lighter than the ground and keep color for the type and the product.
Fill the key word of a tile with the product color as a gradient.

rights.statement: Frame of an Apple event video; copyrighted by Apple Inc. The fan archive states “All rights reserved by Apple Inc.” No image is stored here.
